Dimensionality Configuration

Shared configuration for the dimensionality experiment.

The manifest generators, experiment driver, and plotting utilities use these constants to describe the same data-generating SCM and parameter grid.

dimensionality_config.format_stream_key(stream_key)[source]

Return the stable text representation stored with each result.

dimensionality_config.run_stream_key(domain, param_name, param_value, n_covariates, replicate, scaling)[source]

Return an order-independent SeedSequence.spawn_key for one run.

dimensionality_config.scan_deviation(param_name, param_value)[source]

Return the registered integer offset of a scanned prior value.
